description: Download TikTok videos, slideshow images, covers, and audio to Apify Key-Value Store

assetTypes.description: Which assets to download per post. 'video' = MP4 file, 'images' = slideshow frames, 'audio' = background music MP3, 'cover' = thumbnail JPEG.
assetTypes.title: Asset Types

postIds.description: Numeric TikTok post IDs as strings (alternative to postUrls).
postIds.title: Post IDs

postUrls.description: TikTok post URLs to download (e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123). Accepts full URLs, short URLs, and bare numeric IDs.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

preferredQuality.description: Target video quality. 'best' = highest bitrate. '720p', '540p', '360p' = closest match from bitrateInfo. 'smallest' = lowest bitrate.
preferredQuality.title: Preferred Video Quality

title: TikTok Downloader API Input
